tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground: the icon's paper in light, ink in dark. Behind every screen, the dial hub, the halo round the Log button, the gap between fan wedges, the sheet under pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised paper: the dial disc, cards, bottom sheets, the Trends sheet, circle buttons, text fields, the tally +, menus, banner pills. Sits on bg; it is told apart from bg by shadow-card and a line rim, not by shade (1.1:1).

tokens.name: surface2
tokens.usage: Recessed fill inside a surface: stat tiles, habit chips at rest, the small segmented track, tonal buttons, the stepper circles, the average stepper, the chart readout pill, the 'When it happens' panel.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface, surface2, dangerContainer, clear and a selected chip's tint: 9.9:1 or better in both themes. Also the UndoBar's fill, with bg as its text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: units beside a number, dates, captions, dial numerals, the hub's entry count, the date pill's date, placeholder text, zero tallies, chevrons, field and menu icons. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface, surface2, dangerContainer and a selected chip's tint in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the 1px rim on cards, circle buttons, pills and the dial disc; list dividers; chart gridlines; the hour ring's base circle. Decorative only (1.2:1 light, 1.4:1 dark), so it is never the edge that identifies a control: fields, outlined buttons and the quiet segmented thumb take outline.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control or show a state: a text field's border at rest, outlined and secondary pill buttons, the quiet segmented thumb's border, an unmet password rule's circle, a sheet's grab handle, a slider's track, the chart's cursor line. Ink at 55% (paper at 40% in dark): 3:1 or better in both themes against bg, surface and surface2, including where it is painted over a surface fill and seen against the ground or track beside it (a field's border, the quiet thumb's ring).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Chrome in ink (paper in dark): the primary button and Log button fills, the now-hand, the elapsed arc (at 22%), the scrub knob, selected calendar day, today's ring, the large segmented thumb, the focus outline and a focused field's border. 12.9:1 or better against bg, surface and surface2 in both themes. Never a habit colour.

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: the primary button label, the Log button's +, the selected calendar day, the large segmented thumb's label, a busy button's spinner. 15.4:1 light / 14.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and icons: Delete, Sign out, the refused-write icon and its Dismiss, a field's error text and border. 5.1:1 or better on bg, surface, surface2 and dangerContainer in both themes. Also the fill behind a swiped entry row, with a surface icon (6.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: dangerContainer
tokens.usage: Fill of the danger tonal button, the refused-write Banner and the sign-in error pill. Text on it is text or danger.

tokens.name: data1
tokens.usage: Habit colour 1 (amber), the first habit created. Fill of beads, pips, fan wedges and hour-ring wedges; the chart's area, a selected chip's tint and a tally's flash. In light every filled mark carries data1Rim, which holds 3:1 against each ground (the fill alone is 1.8:1 on surface); thin and hollow marks use data1Ink. In dark the fill holds 3:1 on its own, inside its glow. Data only: never a control, link or selection.

tokens.name: data2
tokens.usage: Habit colour 2 (coral). As data1: in light the rim carries the 3:1 (the fill alone is 2.6:1 on surface); in dark the fill does.

tokens.name: data3
tokens.usage: Habit colour 3 (red). As data1. Red here is a habit, not an error: errors use danger. Dark is a touch lighter than the icon's red, so the bead holds 3:1 inside its glow on surface2.

tokens.name: data4
tokens.usage: Habit colour 4 (violet). As data1. Dark is lighter than the icon's violet, so the bead holds 3:1 inside its glow on surface and surface2.

tokens.name: data5
tokens.usage: Habit colour 5 (blue). As data1: in light the rim carries the 3:1 (the fill alone is 2.7:1 on bg).

tokens.name: data1Ink
tokens.usage: Text and thin marks about habit 1: the tally total, the Trends peek number, the selected chip's border, ring and dotted beads, a pending bead's dashes, ring pips, calendar dots, and on the chart the raw series (dashed), its dots and the average line. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface and surface2 in both themes, and 3:1 or better over the chart's area and a chip's or flash's tint.

tokens.name: data2Ink
tokens.usage: Text and thin marks about habit 2. As data1Ink.

tokens.name: data3Ink
tokens.usage: Text and thin marks about habit 3. As data1Ink.

tokens.name: data4Ink
tokens.usage: Text and thin marks about habit 4. As data1Ink.

tokens.name: data5Ink
tokens.usage: Text and thin marks about habit 5. As data1Ink.

tokens.name: spoke
tokens.usage: The dial's 24 hour spokes, the hour-ring ticks, the fan's dividing spokes. The eight majors (every 3 hours) hold 3:1 in both themes on surface, surface2, the bg past the disc's rim and the clear-day band. On a clear day they fade to 25% with the minors and are decoration (Jack, r8-clear-spokes B, 2026-11-06): the 00/06/12/18 numerals give the time. The minors, at 45% on top, are a decorative grid like line: the numerals, the bead times and the entry sheet carry the time.

tokens.name: clear
tokens.usage: The clear-day wash: a 16px band on the dial at radius 116 when a day has no entries; the clear-day card. Fill only; text and marks on it are text or clearInk.

tokens.name: clearInk
tokens.usage: The clear-day ring (solid, 2px) and its hub copy 'A clear day so far'; a met password rule's filled circle. 5.4:1 or better on bg, surface and clear in both themes, and surface ticks on it hold 6.4:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and the open fan (with a 6px backdrop blur), and the Trends sheet's dim as it rises (up to 90% of this).

tokens.name: wedgeInk
tokens.usage: Labels on the Log fan's wedges, in both themes: 4.6:1 or better on all five fills. The only text that sits on a habit colour.

tokens.name: data1Rim
tokens.usage: A filled habit-1 mark's inner 1.25px rim (bead, pip, fan wedge, hour-ring wedge): data1Ink at 85% in light, which holds 3:1 against surface, surface2, bg, a chip's or flash's tint and the fan's scrim; transparent in dark, where the fill holds 3:1 itself.

tokens.name: data2Rim
tokens.usage: A filled habit-2 mark's rim, as data1Rim.

tokens.name: data3Rim
tokens.usage: A filled habit-3 mark's rim, as data1Rim.

tokens.name: data4Rim
tokens.usage: A filled habit-4 mark's rim, as data1Rim.

tokens.name: data5Rim
tokens.usage: A filled habit-5 mark's rim, as data1Rim.

tokens.name: data1Glow
tokens.usage: A habit-1 bead's glow in dark: data1 at 35%, the bead's own shape blurred 6px behind it (CSS drop-shadow; a Gaussian of sigma 3). At the bead's edge a blurred edge is at most half its strength, so the pairs check the bead against data1Glow@0.5, and it holds 3:1 there. Transparent in light, where the bead has a rim instead.

tokens.name: data2Glow
tokens.usage: A habit-2 bead's glow, as data1Glow.

tokens.name: data3Glow
tokens.usage: A habit-3 bead's glow, as data1Glow.

tokens.name: data4Glow
tokens.usage: A habit-4 bead's glow, as data1Glow.

tokens.name: data5Glow
tokens.usage: A habit-5 bead's glow, as data1Glow.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Red Hat Display, 700 and 900. Titles and the dial's numerals.

styles.name: displayXL
styles.usage: Screen titles: Habits, Settings, a habit's name on its history page. The sign-in wordmark is this face at 42px.

styles.name: displayL
styles.usage: Sheet titles (Trends). The app-bar wordmark is this face at 21px.

styles.name: displayM
styles.usage: The day word in the date pill, bottom-sheet titles at 20px, card titles at 15px.

styles.name: dialNumeral
styles.usage: The four hour numerals round the dial, in muted.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Red Hat Text, 400 to 600. Every word that is not a title or a number.

styles.name: bodyL
styles.usage: Habit names in tally rows and the Habits list, settings row labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A private journal of your days.
styles.usage: Running copy: sheet text, page subtitles, empty states.

styles.name: bodyS
styles.sample: Saved on this device. It will sync when you're back online.
styles.usage: Secondary lines, captions, footnotes, units beside a number, banner detail.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, the UndoBar's Undo, tonal buttons.

styles.name: labelS
styles.usage: The source's 'chips at 13': habit chips, segmented-control segments, section labels, the coach mark.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Red Hat Mono 500 with tabular figures. Numbers only: '2 drinks' is a Mono 2 and a Text 'drinks'.

styles.name: monoXL
styles.usage: The amount in the stepper and on the entry sheet.

styles.name: monoL
styles.usage: The hub clock, stat tile values.

styles.name: monoM
styles.usage: Tally totals, entry times in history, the calendar's day numbers, times inside a label ('Log 2 drinks at 18:30').

styles.name: monoS
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks and dates, in muted.

styles.name: dialTime
styles.usage: The time beside each bead on a day of 4 entries or fewer, in muted, haloed 4px in surface.

spacing.note: A 4px base; the screen gutter is 20.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside pills, the gap between calendar dots.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, fields and the stat tiles; a card's inner padding round a list.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Padding inside stat tiles and list rows; the gap from a pip to its name.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Horizontal inset of the tallies and banner pills; card padding.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Page side padding inside sheets and pages.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between page sections, above a section label.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of sheets above the home indicator.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Large vertical breaks: above the sign-in wordmark, below a page.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: The screen's side gutter: the day nav, the dial column, page content.

radius.note: Circular and orbital: controls are circles or pills; containers are softly rounded.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards: the Habits list, history day groups, settings groups, the menu.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the Trends sheet, top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Stat tiles in Trends.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented tracks and thumbs, the date pill, banners, the UndoBar, the chart readout. In SVG use half the short side, never 999.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text fields: pills like the buttons.

tokens.name: radius-iconTile
tokens.usage: The app icon tile on the sign-in screen (92px).

size.note: Fixed control and dial sizes, in points.

tokens.name: size-logButton
tokens.usage: The Log button circle, docked on the Trends sheet's top edge.

tokens.name: size-circleButton
tokens.usage: Day arrows, back, close and add circles.

tokens.name: size-pillHeight
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: size-chipHeight
tokens.usage: Habit chips, the average stepper's circles.

tokens.name: size-tallyRow
tokens.usage: One tally row under the dial.

tokens.name: size-tallyPlus
tokens.usage: The drawn tally +; its hit area is size-hitArea.

tokens.name: size-hitArea
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target, for every control drawn smaller than it.

tokens.name: size-dial
tokens.usage: The Today dial's square, viewBox -160 -160 320 320.

shadow.note: Light lifts paper with a hairline rim and a soft shadow; dark uses the rim alone, and beads glow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the dial disc, circle buttons, the date pill, the segmented track on bg. Always with a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the Trends sheet, with a 1px line top border.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Anything floating over content: the menu, banner pills, the fan hint, the sign-in icon tile.

tokens.name: shadow-tiny
tokens.usage: Thumbs and circles that sit inside a surface2 track: the small segmented thumb, the average stepper's buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-logButton
tokens.usage: The Log button: a 6px halo in bg that cuts it out of the Trends sheet's edge, then a drop in accent at 60%.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: A focused text field's halo (accent at 22%), with its border turned accent. Buttons take a 2px solid accent outline at 2px offset instead.
